A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors since a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 5 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 275 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
